create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph instance with a specified initial node flag
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn Graph with optional initial and final flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with input and output symbol mappings
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph instances into a single combined graph
